top_signals.title: Trump Hails ‘Great’ Ties With Xi, Downplays Nvidia Spy Scandal
top_signals.summary: US President Donald Trump hailed his great “friendship” with Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping and downplayed a spying scandal involving Nvidia Corp., just hours before leaders of the world’s top two economies meet for talks in China.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
